name: Front desk
tagline: Run a hotel's front desk from its own WhatsApp number: flip an automation switch and the guest's phone shows the result while the code appears beside it.
audience: Developers building a WhatsApp job for a business (hotel notifications as the worked example; bookings, OTP, PBX calls, stickers, media as recipes), in any language over HTTP
flow: Copy the Easy API command, then the front-desk inbox shows the jobs working; recipes, how it works, free vs licensed by job, risk, closing
